title: HELIX: Model-Harness Co-evolution for Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2608.13951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling agent capability has largely focused on improving the model, yet an interactive agent acts through a runtime harness that mediates context, tools, control flow, and stopping. The harness shapes both what a model can accomplish and the trajectories from which it learns. This coupling motivates model-harness co-evolution for recursive self-improvement: build harnesses for a fixed model, update the model from verified sibling trajectories, and rebuild the harnesses as model capabilities change. Realizing this loop requires a controlled way to evolve harnesses while preserving intervention identity and effect. We present HELIX, a source-traceable substrate for harness evolution. HELIX decomposes agent systems into typed ports, reusable atoms, recipes, product shells, and runtime policies. translated_title: HELIX：模型-框架协同进化以实现递归自我改进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13951v1 公告类型：新 摘要：提升智能体能力主要集中于改进模型，然而交互式智能体通过运行时框架（运行时环境）来协调上下文、工具、控制流和停止条件。该框架既塑造了模型能完成的任务，也塑造了其学习所用的轨迹。这种耦合关系促使模型-框架协同进化以实现递归自我改进：为固定模型构建框架，从验证过的兄弟轨迹更新模型，并在模型能力变化时重建框架。实现这一循环需要一种受控的方式来进化框架，同时保持干预的同一性和效果。我们提出了HELIX，一个用于框架进化的源可追踪基板。HELIX将智能体系统分解为类型化端口、可重用原子、配方、产品外壳和运行时策略。它使干预显式且可审计，同时保留轨迹、测试结果和来源信息。因此，框架进化服务于两个相互关联的目标。
tldr: 本文提出HELIX，一种源可追踪的框架进化基板，通过分解智能体系统并保持干预可审计性，实现模型与运行时框架的协同进化以支持递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HELIX, a source-traceable substrate for harness evolution that decomposes agent systems and maintains intervention auditability, enabling model-harness co-evolution for recursive self-improvement.
